title: Recurring state-level LLC taxes, per jurisdiction
description: DRAFT — the pilot's starting contract, expected to change while the pilot runs. `franchiseTax` records a recurring state-level levy on the LLC's existence or privilege of doing business, keyed to substance rather than to the state's label; `stateIncomeTax` records the state's posture toward default pass-through taxation, orientation only. Root states.json stays authoritative for the annual-report payment; `collectedWithAnnualReport` marks the overlap so no consumer counts it twice.

applies.description: false is a researched finding; null means not yet researched.

appliesEvidence.description: Required when applies is false: a passage from a page that would have named a recurring entity tax if one existed — the state's own statement of what an LLC owes annually, so that 'no franchise tax' rests on a page that would have said so.

taxName.description: The state's own label, verbatim: 'Franchise Tax', 'Annual Tax', 'Business Privilege Tax', 'Annual Report License Tax'. The label is data precisely because it disagrees with the substance so often.

basis.description: What the amount scales with. null when applies is false or not yet researched. A regime with a flat floor and a scaled component above it is hybrid, and notes must name both parts.

minimumAnnualUsd.description: The floor an existing LLC pays in an ordinary year. null where the state publishes no minimum, which is not the same as zero: a published $0 minimum (a real case — no-tax-due thresholds) is 0, an absent one is null.

firstYearExemption.description: Statutory first-year waivers. Expiry dates and conditions go to notes.

filedWith.description: The collecting agency's name, verbatim. Most franchise taxes belong to a tax authority, not the Secretary of State; a record that names the wrong agency has copied someone's table.

collectedWithAnnualReport.description: true where this tax IS the annual-report payment that root states.json annual_report_fee already carries. A total-cost consumer must not add the two together.

dueDate.description: The state's own statement, verbatim. Not normalised into a date format — 'the 15th day of the 4th month after the tax year begins' is the fact.

evidence.description: The passage establishing the tax and its figure. null only while applies is null.

passThroughApplies.description: Whether members owe state personal income tax on the LLC's pass-through income. false for the no-income-tax states, and that too needs evidence.

topRatePercent.description: Top marginal individual rate, orientation only. Brackets are out of scope by design.

hasPTETElection.description: Whether the state offers a pass-through entity tax election.

notes.description: Anything the fields cannot carry without lying. The definitional judgment calls live here: why a levy was or was not treated as a franchise-type tax.

needsReview.description: What is missing and what would settle it.

type.description: Trial field, this namespace only: the source class, for deriving record confidence mechanically. null where none of the classes fits; if the field does not survive contact with real sources, dropping it is a pilot outcome, not a failure.

lastVerified.description: The date the cited pages were retrieved and every quoted passage was mechanically confirmed to occur in them.

quote.description: One contiguous verbatim passage, copied from the page as retrieved, artefacts included. Never assembled across an ellipsis, never taken from a search snippet, never tidied.
